subject: Residency impact & 1M-token budget — recap and asks
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@optihealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 16:05:00 -0800 (PST)
Subject: Residency impact & 1M-token budget — recap and asks

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about OptiHealth's roadmap and the two workloads you mentioned (patient messaging + indexing/search inference). Quick recap and a few asks so we can produce a clean budget/quote:

Summary from our side:
- Target pilot: ~1M tokens/month (you mentioned this as a starting point for the POC).
- Primary region preference: EU for PHI-sensitive workloads; US acceptable for non-PII workloads during initial pilot.
- Current target budget range (rough): you indicated a ballpark but we asked to confirm a firm monthly range.

Preliminary unit-econ note (high level):
- Baseline Redwood hosted (US): ~USD 6,200 per 1M tokens (this is a mid-case list price estimate before contract discounts).
- Expected EU premium: +18% (data residency + regional infra/network overhead) — preliminary EU list ~USD 7,300 per 1M tokens.
- Material levers to reduce: prefix/KV caching, quantization (INT8), and batching — can reduce compute line by ~25–35% depending on latency SLOs and model choice.

Asks / next steps for your team:
1) Confirm monthly budget range you are willing to target for the pilot (USD / month) for the 1M token baseline.
2) Confirm which workload absolutely requires EU residency versus which can run in US during pilot.
3) Share any procurement constraints (PO cadence, SOW/DocuSign routing) so we can prepare an aligned quote.

Attachments: opticon-1m-token-estimate.xlsx (detailed line items), redwood-residency-cost-breakdown.pdf (short explainer).

Proposed next call: Thurs 2/17 — 30 minutes — include your CTO and procurement if possible. If you confirm the budget range and residency split, we'll send an itemized pilot quote and a couple of rollout options (EU-only; US+EU hybrid with cross-region fallback).

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

--
Attachment(s): opticon-1m-token-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-residency-cost-breakdown.pdf (document)
From: Samir Rao <samir@optihealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: OptiHealth Procurement <procurement@optihealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 19:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Residency impact & 1M-token budget — recap and asks

Hi Priya,

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Budget: our procurement bucket for the POC is in the range USD 8,000 — 12,000 / month for the first 1M tokens. We need line-item clarity to see if that aligns.
- Residency split: patient messaging must live in EU. Indexing/search inference can start in US for speed while we validate.
- Can you confirm whether logs/usage metadata would remain in-region if we select EU hosting? That is a hard requirement for our compliance team.
- Do the caching/quantization levers you've called out typically get applied at pilot stage (or are they later optimizations)? We are keen to see a conservative and an optimistic cost column.

Would like the itemized quote + a few scenarios (US baseline, EU baseline, EU with quantization, hybrid model with EU-only for PHI). Also loop in your solution architect if possible for the follow-up so our CTO can ask latency/SLAs.

Samir Rao
Head of AI Platforms
OptiHealth
samir@optihealth.com

--
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@optihealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 21:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Residency impact & 1M-token budget — recap and asks

Hi Samir — following up with a concise, conservative itemization to help you evaluate the USD 8k–12k band.

Quick breakdown (per 1M tokens, list-level examples):
- Base compute (inference GPU time, model dependent): USD 3,000
- Inference infra & orchestration overhead (autoscaling, redundancy): USD 1,000
- Network & egress (inter-region transfers, telemetry): USD 500
- Operational support & monitoring (24x7, tracing, trace retention): USD 700
- Data residency premium (EU region ops, storage location guarantees): +18% of subtotal (~USD 1,000)
- Estimated Redwood margin and contract price adjustments: ~USD 1,000

Subtotal (US list example): ~USD 6,200 per 1M tokens
Estimated EU list: ~USD 7,300 per 1M tokens (includes residency premium above)

Optimization scenarios (examples):
- With prefix caching and INT8 quantization: compute line drops ~30% -> net ~USD 5,000 per 1M tokens (US) and ~USD 6,000 (EU).
- If you accept a 50ms increased tail latency on non-PII queries, batching can further reduce compute cost another ~10–15%.

Compliance note: when you select EU region for hosting + a private residency flag in the contract, logs and usage metadata are provisioned to remain in the EU tenant; we can include contractual language and an AWS/GCP region list in the SOW. I'll add our Security SA to the next call if you want more legal/compliance detail.

Attached: I am attaching a stripped-down MLA-friendly one-pager and the same estimate workbook Priya referenced.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Thanks — that breakdown helps a lot. Let's schedule Thu 2/17 at 11:00am CET for a 30-minute sync with our CTO (I've sent a calendar invite). Procurement will also be on the call; they'll want the itemized quote and a standard PO flow.

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Please send the two-scenario PDF (conservative list + optimized with quantization) so procurement can pre-review.
2) Confirm the EU log/data residency clause you mentioned — if you can send the proposed language that would speed legal signoff.

I'll circulate any procurement templates we require prior to the call.

Samir
